changelog:
trpg-general-requirements v1.0.0

- Initial release providing standardized requirements and deliverable structure for TRPG rule generation projects.
- Specifies comprehensive output list: detailed rulebooks for players/GM, scenario scripts (in Markdown + YAML), Excel role sheets, maps (YAML + SVG), and optional catalogs, all in traditional Chinese.
- Enforces strict rules: all game terminology must use "中文全稱（縮寫）" without stand-alone English short forms in any user-facing document.
- Requires all materials and formulas in Excel sheets to be prepared in traditional Chinese, with full automation for calculated fields.
- Deliverables must support both single-player+GM and multi-player+GM modes by default.
- Outlines a clear directory structure for all outputs; includes cleanup guidance for working files.
summary: Use this skill when writing or generating TRPG rules from a requirements specification. Triggers on: generate rules, write rulebook, create TRPG system, 生成规则...
